servinfo.title: Flywheel / Drive Plate Removal and Installation

s1.ptxt: For M/T model, remove clutch cover and clutch disc.
For A/T model, remove transaxle assembly.
Lock flywheel (M/T model) or drive plate (A/T model) using special tool as shown in figure.
Remove flywheel (M/T model) or drive plate (A/T model) from crankshaft.
For A/T model, separate drive plate flange and drive rear plate from drive plate.
Install flywheel (M/T model) or drive plate (A/T model) according to the following procedure.

attention4.ptxt: The flywheel bolts (M/T model) or drive plate bolts (A/T model) are pre-coated with adhesive. If these bolts are reused, they may work loose.
Replace the flywheel bolts (M/T model) or drive plate bolts (A/T model) with new ones whenever they are removed.

s2.ptxt: For M/T model, install new flywheel bolts.
For A/T model, install drive plate flange, drive plate and drive rear plate using new drive plate bolts.
Lock flywheel (M/T model) or drive plate (A/T model) using special tool as shown in figure.
For M/T model, tighten all flywheel bolts evenly and gradually to 20 N·m (2.0 kgf-m, 15.0 lbf-ft).
For A/T model, tighten drive plate bolts to specified torque.

s1.ptxt: For M/T model, install clutch cover and clutch disc.
For A/T model, install transmission assembly.
